description: An adverse drug reaction reported in regulatory drug package insert labels, from SIDER. Each concept uses a MedDRA-normalized UMLS identifier rather than the raw label-extracted identifier. Coverage includes preferred terms, lowest-level terms and broad MedDRA grouping categories. These concepts are separate from Symptom nodes, with no cross-links supplied by this source.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier for the MedDRA-normalized side effect, prefixed umls: (for example umls:C0000737).

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: MedDRA term name for the side effect.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the side-effect concept.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the node was created or its properties changed.

source_contributions.scope: Adverse drug reaction concepts in drug package insert labels. Preferred terms, lowest-level terms and broad grouping categories are included. Coverage is limited to source associations with a represented Compound and non-null compound identifier, side-effect identifier and name.
source_contributions.description: SIDER (Side Effect Resource) supplies adverse drug reaction concepts and names standardized through MedDRA. Identifiers refer to the MedDRA-normalized UMLS concept, which can differ in granularity from the term originally extracted from a label.
